title: Entry: dashboard, invite, admission, prejoin, embed and boot

facts.name: admission.decision
facts.doc: The API's admission decision for a join attempt. Claim: admitted, or the refusal reason.

symptoms.doc: A join attempt never got an admission decision, so the person waited on a screen that never resolved.

witnesses.query: axiom <api-log-dataset> | where client_session_id == '{attempt}' and kind == 'decision' and name in ('invite.resolve', 'admission.decided')
witnesses.doc: The decision that admits or refuses the attempt.
